sections.text: Ask Claude Code's most capable model the wrong question, and your request can be handed to a different model.
Fable five point two runs with safety classifiers. They mostly watch for two things: cybersecurity, and biology.
When one flags your request, Claude Code doesn't stop. It re-runs the same request on another model. Biology goes to Opus five. Cybersecurity goes to Opus four point eight.

And it can trigger on your very first message. That request also carries your CLAUDE dot M D and your git status. A repo with security material can trip it before you type a word. After that, the session stays on the fallback.
So if Fable suddenly feels different, look for the notice in your transcript. Then type slash model to switch back.
